title: 第5章
content_zh:
看着电脑里的数据夏真钰还真是发愁，这么多的数据逐条核对，哪能做得完呢，要是信息部门平时能认真点，也不至于这时候这么没措手不及了，现在只能尽力做了，能核对多少是多少吧。
结果大部分人几乎都加了一夜的班，简单的洗漱了下，因为没准备所以平时的化妆品也没带，只能素着脸了。
接到电话是说周瑾宇九点半会到办事大厅视察，结果都十多了人也没来，市里、区里大大小小的领导全都聚集在大门口不停张望，虽说有被批的风险，不过如果做得好也会给周瑾宇留下好印象啊。
夏真钰一宿都没怎么合眼，现在更是坐在电脑前等得直无精打采的，今天她的任务非常重要，周市长一会儿来的时候，必定要看系统操作的，那么就得由她来完成电脑演示工作。
其实怎么也不应该轮到她露这个脸的，可就因为信息部门准备得不充分，有很大可能存在信息不准确或者是逻辑错误，因此在没人愿意冒风险的情况下，她这个编外便被推上了前线。
她是无所胃的，升官发财都和她没关系，即使出了错，周瑾宇那么大的领导也根本不可能拿她兴师问罪，倒霉的还是那些官儿。
终于快十一点的时候，在几辆警车开道下，一辆辆黑色轿车开了过来，所有人都立即来了精神，包括夏真钰也是，能亲眼近距离目睹周瑾宇的风采也真是难得的机遇了。
夏真钰站了起来，看见在众人陪同下，周瑾宇缓步过了大厅，旁边是她们单位信息中心的主任，正不停的汇报情况。
在终于看清周瑾宇的同时，夏真钰不得不真心叹服，这真是个极品的男人，一米八几的身高腰身却挺得笔直，身材比例十分完美，英俊的脸庞充满了温文尔雅的气质，双眼璀璨如星，高挺的鼻梁，嘴边一抹温和的笑，很容易让人生出亲近之感，魅力十足。
这哪像快４０岁的人哪，夏真钰暗自赞叹周瑾宇保养得方，看他的样子挺多３０出头，难怪风靡全市乃至全省。
随着众人的引导，周瑾宇往系统中心这边走来，夏真钰越发看清了他的表情，除了随身记者一直在拍摄、照相外，只见被十几个人围绕着奉承的周瑾宇，依然只是温和的微笑，让人如沐春风，但夏真钰看得很清楚，周瑾宇的眼神丝毫没有笑意，寒冷如冰。
夏真钰虽然懒散，可对别人的一言一行很敏感，不然以她这个编外的临时工身份，这么些年怎么在这种机关单位明哲保身呢，周瑾宇这人绝对是只笑面虎，这种人最可怕，尤其像混到周瑾宇这种段数的人，估计别人被他整死了还要感谢他呢。
夏真钰平时也最怕和这样的人打交道，这种人心机和城府都太深了，管他周瑾宇是什么人呢，只要把今天的任务完成就万事大吉了。
这时他们已经来到了夏真钰的面前，夏真钰赶紧挺直腰板站好等候吩咐，只听见周瑾宇富有磁性的嗓音传了过来：进展还不错，一会儿再详细说说，先看看系统吧。
话刚说完夏真钰一下子就被旁边的记者拉到椅子上坐下了，新闻灯直接打在她的右边脸上，这时周瑾宇也自行坐在了她的左手边，然后说道：先调出数据看看。
夏真钰这才紧张起来，现在是真正的关键时刻了，新闻灯照离自己右边脸非常近，摄像、摄影记者不停的取角度拍摄，弄得她现在一身汗。暗暗深吸了一口气，按照周瑾宇的要求调出了相关数据记录，估计他也是走走过场吧，不一定能看懂。
看了一会数据信息，周瑾宇又让她调出了其他一些项目，然后出声问道：这个项目数据是怎么来的？
夏真钰一听这周市长还真是个行家啊，调出其他项目就对比出刚才那些数据的逻辑关系不对了，心中忐忑得很，自己要怎么回答啊，说数据错了？还是说和自己没关系是信息中心的人做的？显然哪种回答自己都别想好。
正鼓足勇气面向周瑾宇准备说自己是新来的不太清楚时，才发现周瑾宇压根儿没看她，而是在看着她们的一把主任郭怀发问。
真是个好领导啊，知道冤有头、债有主，不为难最基层的人员，夏真钰感激起周瑾宇来。郭主任被周瑾宇看得汗如雨下却不敢擦，嘴里只说：这个、这个可能是工作人员失误了吧。

周瑾宇脸上笑意已经很淡了，轻声说：这么多项目数据混乱不清，你就用失误两个字解释？我看也不用上楼听汇报了。
大厅几十号人却鸦雀无声，夏真钰也憋着气，大气不敢喘，她看郭主任已经有些缺氧的先兆了，不会真丢官吧？在所有人都急得束手无策的时候，周瑾宇身边的一个中年男子，应该是周瑾宇副手之类的吧，对着众人说道：周市长说的话都听到了吧？这样的错误一定要改，今后不能再出现这种情况了。
这句话算是解了围了，几十道声音立即抢着说：是、是，改、改，一定改，立即就改。
周瑾宇听了没说话，只是起身向大门走去，看来是真不听她们领导准备了一夜的汇报了。看着他离去，夏真钰总算松了一口气，终于送走这尊大佛了。
准备收拾东西好好休息下，身后又传来脚步声，夏真钰一回头愣住了，这周瑾宇怎么又回来了？
只见周瑾宇来到自己身边站定，然后伸出手说道：你好。
夏真钰慌乱的伸手和周瑾宇握了下，周瑾宇握手用的力道很柔和，只轻握了下自己手便松开了，夏真钰没想周瑾宇会回来和她握手，一下子有些蒙，不知道如何是好，结果回了这么一句：首长好！
这句话说完大厅再次冷场，夏真钰很绝望，自己明明想说的是市长好！怎么成首长了，首长哪是给周瑾宇用的啊，又赶忙弥补：对不起，我一时紧张，我、我想的说是——
周瑾宇轻声笑了：不用紧张，没关系的，刚才辛苦你了。
周瑾宇看着眼前这个脸涨得通红的小姑娘是真的笑了，没想到这些人会让个生手来演示系统，估计是知道过不了关才让她顶缸的吧，所以刚才发现错误时自己并没为难她。
夏真钰单位的领导估计是怕她再顺嘴回答个什么为人民服务之类的，立即就代她对周瑾宇说：不辛苦，这是应该的，能为周市长服务是我们大家的荣幸。
周瑾宇没理会，就问夏真钰：你是什么学校毕业的，是考进来的？
身边的人又帮忙回答了问题，夏真钰没想到领导这么重视自己，把自己的履历都背下来了，估计也是怕周瑾宇顺口问吧。
周瑾宇听了知道眼前这个女孩子原来是没编制合同工，难怪他们把她推上前线了，又笑着问夏真钰一个月的工资是多少。
夏真钰微低着头不说话，反正问什么都由别人替她回答了，不过这次却没人说话了，夏真钰等了几秒钟，发现这回是真没人插话了，抬起头看周瑾宇温和的看着自己，于是小声报了工资数，合同工和正式编制是没有可比性的，活儿一样不少干，但工资连他们的五分一都赶不上。
周瑾宇听完说道：少了点。
夏真钰已经完全不紧张了，对着周瑾宇微笑：是少了点。
周瑾宇听了夏真钰的附和朗笑出声，其他人看周瑾宇终于情绪好了，一下子也都跟着哈哈大笑，再次和夏真钰握了手，周瑾宇这回是真的走了。
☆、意想不到之福
距上次周瑾宇视察已经过去快半个月了，整个办事大厅从上到下都在为改进信息系统的工作异常忙碌，各个部门也没有相互推诿，郭主任已经发了话，谁再出问题自己被拿下前就先让那人回家。

一有事情忙，就没人再有心思成天说闲话了，所以对于夏真钰婚礼的简陋，以及婚前脚受伤不能去度蜜月的事情也渐渐少了议论，取而代之的则是那天郭主任的窘态和周瑾宇的风度翩翩。
这段日子让夏真钰最挂心的还是和李巍的事情，两人也不能总这么没夫妻之实的僵着啊，时间长了问题会越积越严重的。
所以夏真钰今天下了班特意去买了红酒，又到西餐厅点了外卖，准备回家布置一下再放点音乐，和李巍吃顿有情调的晚餐，气氛缓和了自然就能放松的谈问题了。
刚一起布置，拎着一堆东西先放到门口的柜子上走了进去，结果就看见李巍正在沙发上，茶几上摆着饭菜正吃着呢，李巍他妈宋娟坐在旁边的沙发上把好几包衣服堆在地板上，正往外拿呢。
宋娟看夏真钰回来了，笑着说：回来啦，快来看看，这么些衣服你看哪件好就留下，剩下的我再拿回去看有我能穿的没。
夏真钰有些莫名，这么些衣服哪来的，也不像新啊，就问道：妈，这些是从哪来的啊？说完又看了眼吃得正香的李巍，也不问问自己吃饭了没有。
李巍他二姨的女儿璐璐在南边城市的海关部门工作，这些都是她不穿的了，那丫头买衣服从来不考虑，看中了就买，等买到家又不见得喜欢。这不，你看摘标签还在上面呢。
看了看确实基本都是八成新的没太穿过的衣服，而且有几件真是压根儿没穿过，标签都没摘下来的，而且这些衣服还都是名牌，但自己再怎么着也不至于捡别人的衣服穿吧，买不起名牌就穿一般的呗。
于是笑了笑说：二姨还真有心了，璐璐也费心了这么老远邮回来得不少钱吧？不过妈你看璐璐和我身材对不上号啊，恐怕我穿不了。
content_en:
Looking at the data in the computer, Xia Zhenyu was really worried. How could he finish checking so much data one by one? If the information department could be more serious at ordinary times, it would not be so unprepared at this time. Now he can only do his best and check as much as he can.
As a result, most people worked overtime all night and simply washed up. Because they were not prepared, they did not bring their usual cosmetics and could only keep their faces bare.
I received a call saying that Zhou Jinyu would come to inspect the service hall at 9:30, but more than ten people did not come. All the leaders of the city and district gathered at the gate and kept looking around. Although there was a risk of being criticized, if they did well, they would leave a good impression on Zhou Jinyu.
Xia Zhenyu didn't sleep much all night, and now she was sitting in front of the computer waiting listlessly. Her task today was very important. When Mayor Zhou came soon, he would have to watch the system operation, so she would have to complete the computer demonstration.
In fact, it should never have been her turn to show her face like this, but because the information department was not fully prepared, there was a high possibility of inaccurate information or logical errors. Therefore, when no one was willing to take risks, she, a non-staff member, was pushed to the front line.
She has no appetite, and promotion and wealth have nothing to do with her. Even if something goes wrong, it is impossible for a leader as big as Zhou Jinyu to hold her accountable. It is the officials who are unlucky.
Finally, when it was almost eleven o'clock, several police cars cleared the way, and black cars drove over. Everyone immediately became energetic, including Xia Zhenyu. It was a rare opportunity to see Zhou Jinyu's style up close.
Xia Zhenyu stood up and saw Zhou Jinyu slowly walking through the hall accompanied by everyone. Next to him was the director of their unit's information center, who was constantly reporting on the situation.
When he finally saw Zhou Jinyu clearly, Xia Zhenyu had to sincerely admire him. He was really a top-notch man. He was over 1.8 meters tall but had a straight waist and perfect body proportions. His handsome face was full of gentle and elegant temperament. His eyes were as bright as stars, his nose was high, and he had a gentle smile on his lips. He easily made people feel close to him and he was full of charm.
He didn't look like someone who was almost 40 years old. Xia Zhenyu secretly praised Zhou Jinyu for taking good care of himself. He looked like he was in his early 30s. No wonder it became popular in the city and even the province.
Following the guidance of the crowd, Zhou Jinyu walked towards the system center. Xia Zhenyu could see his expression more and more clearly. In addition to the accompanying reporters who had been filming and taking pictures, Zhou Jinyu, who was surrounded by more than a dozen people and flattered him, still had only a gentle smile, which made people feel like spring breeze. But Xia Zhenyu could see clearly that Zhou Jinyu's eyes were not smiling at all and were as cold as ice.
Although Xia Zhenyu is lazy, she is very sensitive to other people's words and deeds. Otherwise, as a non-staff temporary worker, how could she keep herself safe in such an agency all these years? Zhou Jinyu is definitely a smiley person. This kind of person is the most terrifying, especially someone like Zhou Jinyu who has mixed up. It is estimated that others will thank him for being tortured to death by him.
Xia Zhenyu is usually most afraid of dealing with such people. Such people are too scheming and sophisticated. No matter who Zhou Jinyu is, as long as he completes today's task, everything will be fine.
At this time, they had arrived in front of Xia Zhenyu. Xia Zhenyu quickly straightened his back and stood up waiting for instructions. He only heard Zhou Jinyu's magnetic voice coming over: The progress is not bad. I will talk about it in detail later. Let's take a look at the system first.
As soon as she finished speaking, Xia Zhenyu was pulled to a chair by the reporter next to her and sat down. The news light hit the right side of her face directly. At this time, Zhou Jinyu also sat on her left side and said: First, pull up the data and take a look.
Xia Zhenyu became nervous now. Now was the real critical moment. The news light was very close to the right side of his face. Cameras and photographers kept taking pictures from different angles.The photo made her sweat all over. Secretly taking a deep breath, he called up the relevant data records according to Zhou Jinyu's request. He was probably just going through the motions and might not be able to understand.
After looking at the data information for a while, Zhou Jinyu asked her to call up some other projects, and then asked aloud: Where did the data for this project come from?
When Xia Zhenyu heard that the mayor this week was really an expert, he compared other projects and found out that the logical relationship of the data just now was wrong. He felt very uneasy. How should he answer that the data was wrong? Or do you think it has nothing to do with you and it was done by the people at the information center? Obviously, you can’t think of any answer yourself.
Just when she mustered up the courage to face Zhou Jinyu and was about to say that she was new here and didn't know clearly, she realized that Zhou Jinyu wasn't looking at her at all, but was looking at their director Guo Huai to ask questions.
What a good leader. He knows that every grievance has its owner and every debt has its owner, and he does not embarrass the most basic personnel. Xia Zhenyu was grateful to Zhou Jinyu. Director Guo was sweating profusely when Zhou Jinyu saw him, but he didn't dare to wipe it off. He just said: This, this may be a mistake by the staff.
The smile on Zhou Jinyu's face had faded, and he said softly: So many project data are confusing and unclear, so you just use the word "mistake" to explain? I don’t think I need to go upstairs to listen to the report.
There was total silence among the dozens of people in the hall. Xia Zhenyu was also holding her breath and did not dare to take a breath. She saw that Director Guo already had some signs of hypoxia. He would not really lose his official position, right? When everyone was helpless in a hurry, a middle-aged man next to Zhou Jinyu, who should be Deputy Zhou Jinyu or something, said to everyone: Did you hear what Mayor Zhou said? This kind of mistake must be corrected so that it cannot happen again in the future.
This sentence solved the problem, and dozens of voices immediately rushed to say: Yes, yes, change it, change it, I must change it, and change it immediately.
Zhou Jinyu didn't say anything after hearing this. He just stood up and walked towards the door. It seemed that he really didn't listen to the report prepared by their leader all night. Watching him leave, Xia Zhenyu finally breathed a sigh of relief and finally saw off the giant Buddha.
When he was about to pack his things and take a good rest, he heard footsteps again behind him. Xia Zhenyu turned around and was stunned. Why is Zhou Jinyu back this time?
Zhou Jinyu came to stand next to him, then stretched out his hand and said: Hello.
Xia Zhenyu reached out in panic and shook Zhou Jinyu's hand. Zhou Jinyu's handshake was very gentle. He only lightly squeezed her hand and then let go.
After saying this, the hall fell into silence again. Xia Zhenyu was very desperate. What he clearly wanted to say was, hello to the mayor! Why did he become the chief? How could the chief be used by Zhou Jinyu? He quickly made up for it: I'm sorry, I was nervous for a moment. I, what I wanted to say was——
Zhou Jinyu laughed softly: Don't be nervous, it's okay, I thanked you for your hard work just now.
Zhou Jinyu really smiled when he looked at the blushing little girl in front of him. He didn't expect these people to let a novice demonstrate the system. He probably let her push the tank because he knew she couldn't pass the test, so he didn't embarrass her when he discovered the mistake just now.
The leader of Xia Zhenyu's unit was probably afraid that she would give another casual answer about serving the people, so he immediately said to Zhou Jinyu on her behalf: "It's not hard work, it's what you should do. It's an honor for all of us to serve Mayor Zhou."
Zhou Jinyu ignored it and asked Xia Zhenyu: What school did you graduate from and were you admitted?
The people around him helped answer the questions. Xia Zhenyu didn't expect that the leader would take him so seriously and memorized his resume. He was probably afraid that Zhou Jinyu would ask casually.
After hearing this, Zhou Jinyu knew that the girl in front of him was an unemployed contract worker. No wonder they pushed her to the front line. He smiled and asked Xia Zhenyu how much her monthly salary was.
Xia Zhenyu lowered her head slightly and said nothing. Anyway, others would answer her questions for her, but this time there was no one.After talking, Xia Zhenyu waited for a few seconds and found that no one was interrupting this time. He raised his head and saw Zhou Jinyu looking at him gently, so he reported the salary in a low voice. There was no comparison between contract workers and formal employees. They also had a lot of work, but the salary could not even catch up to one-fifth of their wages.
After hearing this, Zhou Jinyu said: A little less.
Xia Zhenyu was no longer nervous at all, and smiled at Zhou Jinyu: It's a little less.
Zhou Jinyu laughed out loud after hearing Xia Zhenyu's agreement. Seeing that Zhou Jinyu finally got better, the others laughed along with them and shook hands with Xia Zhenyu again. Zhou Jinyu really left this time.
☆Unexpected blessing
Nearly half a month has passed since Zhou Jinyu's last inspection. The entire office hall is extremely busy from top to bottom working on improving the information system. Various departments are not pushing the blame with each other. Director Guo has already issued a message that if anyone causes problems again, he will be sent home before he is taken down.
When things are busy, no one has the energy to gossip all day long, so there is gradually less talk about Xia Zhenyu's shabby wedding and the fact that he injured his foot before the wedding and was unable to go on honeymoon. Instead, they talked about Director Guo's embarrassment and Zhou Jinyu's elegant demeanor that day.
What worries Xia Zhenyu the most during these days is the matter with Li Wei. The two of them can't always be so frozen without the reality of being a couple. As time goes by, the problems will accumulate and become more serious.
So Xia Zhenyu went out to buy red wine after work today, and ordered takeout from a Western restaurant. He planned to go home, decorate and play some music, and have a romantic dinner with Li Wei. After the atmosphere relaxed, he could naturally talk about problems in a relaxed manner.
As soon as they set it up together, they put a bunch of things on the cabinet at the door and walked in. They saw Li Wei sitting on the sofa with food on the coffee table and eating. Li Wei's mother, Song Juan, was sitting on the sofa next to her and piled several bags of clothes on the floor and was taking them out.
Song Juan saw that Xia Zhenyu was back and said with a smile: You're back. Come and take a look. You can keep any of these clothes that you like. I'll take the rest back to see if I can wear them.
Xia Zhenyu was a little confused. Where did these clothes come from? They didn't look new, so he asked: Mom, where did these come from? After saying that, he glanced at Li Wei who was eating deliciously, without asking if he had eaten yet.
Li Wei's second aunt's daughter Lulu works in the customs department in the southern city. She no longer wears these. That girl never considers clothes when buying them. No, look, the label is still on it.
After looking at it, it is true that most of them are 80% new clothes that have not been worn very much, and some of them have never been worn at all, and the tags have not been removed. Moreover, these clothes are all famous brands, but no matter what I wear, I will not pick up other people's clothes and wear them. If I can't afford famous brands, I will just wear ordinary clothes.
So she smiled and said: Second aunt is really thoughtful, Lulu also took the trouble to mail it back from such a long distance, right? But Mom, you see Lulu and I don’t have the right figure. I’m afraid I can’t wear it.
